section:Groove-Pool.notes: Groove Pool (View menu > Groove Pool, Ctrl+Alt+6) confirmed rendered and visible (panel node present with an empty Tree and no children) in a maximized window. No automation_ids and no exposed controls — custom-rendered list. IMPORTANT: opening/toggling this panel crashed Ableton Live 12 twice in a row (Event Log Application: Ableton Live 12 Suite.exe faulting in ucrtbase.dll, exception 0xc0000409, BEX64 stack-buffer-overrun, same fault bucket both times). The dump above is valid (panel was open when captured); do NOT re-open Groove Pool. Recorded per AGENTS.md 7.

UIA tree exposes NO nodes for the Info panel — the view is custom-rendered (canvas/offscreen text) with no automation_ids and no children, even while active. Genuinely opaque, not a capture failure: the toggle was confirmed active by the menu state and the dump was taken with the panel visibly open. Recorded per AGENTS.md 7.
